task.title: To create a Clear action
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Clear from the

step.cmd: Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Clear from the drop-down. The Clear Fields Action window opens.
In the Action Name field, type a descriptive name for the action.
To disable excel events while performing display actions, select the Disable Excel Events during execution checkbox.
From the Display / Save Map drop-down, select an existing map.
Click the check box next to the object to be cleared and it will be displayed in Selected Objects.
Click Save. You can select additional Save Maps and objects as necessary.
